- **Repository base SHA / delivered SHA:** accepted PB2-19 base `3ac2753e5f34534e6e3acb786c4e12728e3dcc87`; no delivered commit exists yet. Seth-arc authored and committed the reviewed Prompt 19 result at `2026-10-10T23:02:31-04:00`, the acceptance event under AM-GOV-001/048.
- **Canonical inputs and version/hash:** source manifest `4ce13c6d0fa6eb7d99f4e7023a7c48669bb57407827dc83f661f8ab6eccbb436`; Technical Architecture v2 `982be4ecd82b996e14be83b6fd89a60a2876bb4e2505ed195889ad4f81dcee30`; Prompt 20 `0f3d40e5869ee25d0c3e973aae0407ec963610ff3ba4a8511d29abec1695e0e2`; accepted application port contract `1.2.0`; new adapter contract `1.0.0`.
- **Implementation files changed and why:** `packages/application` adds schema-valid/hash-verified immutable artifact loading, IndexedDB current/recovery storage, Web Locks edit authority, revision-safe sync status, deterministic narrative failover and player projection/cache facades. UI drops its direct domain dependency. ESLint and two negative fixtures enforce projection-only UI and no web-to-simulation import. Tests and build docs pin behavior, proposals, ownership and acceptance evidence.
- **Contracts added/changed and downstream compatibility:** exact Technical v2 `CampaignArtifactRefs`, release-manifest and map-manifest schemas are public. Projection, resolved-URL, sync-record and injectable-storage shapes are AM-GOV-049 TEST_ONLY proposals. The frozen generic `SimulationPort` is consumed unchanged; no duplicate engine exists. UI's allowed dependency narrows from domain+application to application only. The accepted Prompt 08 SaveSnapshot remains unchanged and therefore still needs an approved v2 artifact-pin migration before production resume/initialization.
- **Fixed seed/fixtures:** the accepted deterministic four-month content and Prompt 19 initial campaign fixture are reused. No new random seed, production data, live source or external network request is introduced. Artifact responses are in-memory synthetic JSON with canonical hashes.
- **Test command + exit code + real output/log path:** `docs/build/logs/20-test.log` records initial environment/type failures, corrections, the final 11/11 focused suite, boundary checks, full CI, governance and final diff checks. No failed or skipped test is hidden.
- **Negative tests and independent fixture ID:** stale/equal durable revision; runtime unchanged before durable commit; source hash mismatch; resolved URL/hash mismatch before fetch; alternate CampaignArtifactRefs shape; stale projection; old cache invalidation; resolver trace exclusion; stale sync completion; offline primary narrative; `ui-imports-domain.ts`; `web-imports-simulation.ts`.
- **Not tested / reasons:** no approved SaveSnapshot artifact migration, browser fallback lease fields/timings, cloud backend/auth/transport, real-browser IndexedDB upgrade/recovery, PMTiles publication, production artifact retention/source admission, production narrative provider, localization, production content or downstream UI exists. These remain explicit blockers, not PASS results.
- **Open decisions and scope exclusions:** browsers without Web Locks fail closed pending approved IndexedDB/message lease semantics. Cloud conflict resolution remains metadata-only and cannot merge/replace campaign state. Existing campaigns never substitute current-release artifacts. Narrative remains plain text and non-authoritative. No map binary or live source update enters an active campaign.
- **Evidence artifacts / verifier and owner sign-off:** `docs/build/PRODUCTION_APPLICATION_ADAPTER_CONTRACT.md`, AM-GOV-048/049, `docs/build/ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE.md`, `docs/build/DOMAIN_CONTRACT_INVENTORY.md`, `docs/build/BUILD_STATE.json`, this handoff and `docs/build/logs/20-test.log`. No Prompt 20 owner sign-off or ACCEPTED state is claimed.
- **Next prerequisite and revalidation requirements:** an independent reviewer should run the commands below from a frozen install, inspect the blocked migration/lease items, and review all TEST_ONLY public shapes. The repository owner may then record an accepting commit under AM-GOV-001. PB2-21 must not begin before PB2-20 is ACCEPTED.

## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/application-adapters.test.ts
corepack pnpm run test:boundaries
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git diff --stat
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 11/11; both forbidden imports are rejected; full CI and 7/7 governance tests exit 0; artifact mismatches and stale revisions fail closed; runtime changes only after durable local commit; old projection cache entries disappear on revision change; offline narrative uses deterministic fallback; the exact changed paths match this handoff; and Prompt 20 remains `READY_FOR_REVIEW` with no approval metadata.

## Diff summary

Prompt 20 adds application-owned production adapter foundations while retaining simulation as the sole engine: immutable artifact verification, local current/recovery persistence, exclusive editing, revision-safe sync metadata, knowledge-safe projections/cache and narrative failover. It narrows UI dependencies to the application facade, adds executable negative boundaries, reconciles the owner-reviewed Prompt 19 acceptance, and leaves every unavailable production migration/provider/lease choice visibly blocked.
